integrity: The face list is reconstructed from Cervone's labeled 1133 face table; exact integer determinant and mod-two row-reduction checks are independently replayable from verify.py.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to Cervone's unique 1133 eight-vertex Klein-bottle triangulation and classifies only simple three-edge cycles. The literature search leaves residual risk of an unindexed historical finite computation. The source date is the earliest exact public full-text snapshot verified for the Cervone paper, not its journal issue date.
title: Empty triangles realize all shortest integral homology types in the 1133 minimal Klein bottle
